fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow held at full draw for 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fistful of Arrows
fusions.desc: Looses 2 arrows at once from the spares held in your draw hand, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Anchor Point
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
